viewCommand.label: Show the bar (anyone). Mods can also adjust it: !bar +5, !bar -5, !bar set 30

lockCommand.label: Lock the bar by hand (mods). A bare number is seconds, so !barlock 60 is a minute; !barlock 5m and !barlock 1h work too, and a mod's lock ignores the usual caps

nopeCommand.label: Save the run by hand while the clock is running (mods)

fillCommand.label: Fill the bar and start the clock (mods), for rehearsing the panic

subCommand.label: Pretend some subs just arrived, for testing (mods): !barsub 5, or !barsub 3 t3 for tier 3. A minus takes them back off as a correction: !barsub -1. Behaves exactly like a real gift, including ending the run outright if it is big enough

bitsCommand.label: Add a number of bits to the bar by hand (mods): !barbits 500. It behaves exactly like a real cheer. A minus takes them back off as a correction: !barbits -500

onCommand.label: Switch the bar on for a Getting Over It stream (mods). Anything that was counting down carries on from where it stopped

offCommand.label: Switch the bar off for every other stream (mods). Subs, bits, tips and redeems stop counting and the clocks stand still

resetCommand.label: Clear everything back to an empty, unlocked bar (mods). Add a bar number to go to that bar, so !barreset 1 goes back to the first one

whoCanManage.label: Who can drive the bar from chat

capacity.label: How many points the first bar holds before the run resets (a tier 1 sub is 5 points by default, so 100 is twenty subs, or 5,000 bits, or 50 in donations). Every bar after it is bigger

capacityGrowth.label: How much bigger each bar is than the last after a successful reset, and how much more it costs to save the run (1.5 means half as big again, 2 means double, 1 means it never grows). Always rounded to whole numbers

nopeSeconds.label: Seconds chat gets to save the run once the bar is full

resetHoldSeconds.label: Seconds the reset banner stays up before the bar clears itself

saveExtendSeconds.label: Seconds a sub, a cheer or a donation adds back onto the clock while chat is saving the run, on top of chipping into the save (0 turns it off)

saveGraceSeconds.label: Seconds after the bar fills that subs do not count towards saving it, so subs that were meant to fill the bar do not end up saving it (0 turns it off)

dreadFrom.label: How close to the top the bar starts warming towards the alarm colour and breathing, in points (25 means the last five tier 1 subs' worth). 0 turns it off

overkillCosplay.label: Instead of ending the run outright, a contribution this big is just a very big contribution, with a joke line instead of ending anything

overkillSubs.label: One contribution worth this many points ends the run outright, with no window to save it (500 is a hundred gifted tier 1 subs). It doubles every time the bar grows up to it, so an ordinary bar never catches it. 0 turns it off

debug.label: Log every event to the browser console (leave on until the channel point rewards are confirmed working)

cosplayTitle.label: The line that shows instead of ending the run, when the above is ticked
cosplayTitle.value: You didn't get over it, time to cosplay

label.label: Name above the bar while it is filling

pendingTitle.label: Headline while the bar is full and the clock is running

overkillTitle.label: Headline when one person ended it outright and there was no window at all

showFloat.label: Float a little +N above the card naming whoever just spent

hideWhenOff.label: Hide the bar entirely while it is switched off, rather than showing it faded

showLock.label: Show a little padlock on the card while the bar is locked

subTier1.label: Points a tier 1 sub fills (Prime counts as tier 1). Donations are priced against this one too

bitsPer100.label: Points every 100 bits fills (2 makes 5,000 bits fill the first bar of 100 points, the same as twenty tier 1 subs)

tipPerSub.label: How much money in a Ko-fi or StreamElements donation counts as one tier 1 sub (2.50 makes 1 in donations worth 2 points, and 50 fill the first bar, in whatever currency the channel takes)

currencySymbol.label: Currency symbol shown in the line under the bar for how much money is left to go

fillRewardTitle.label: Channel point reward that fills the bar (matched on the start of the title)

fillRewardAmount.label: Points that reward fills (5 means a redeem is worth a tier 1 sub)

pushBackRewardTitle.label: Channel point reward that pushes the bar back (matched on the start of the title). Only works while the bar is filling

pushBackAmount.label: How many points that reward takes off the first bar (10 is two tier 1 subs' worth, a tenth of it). It grows with each bar by the same amount the bar does. 0 turns the reward off

lockRewardTitle.label: Channel point reward that locks the bar (matched on the start of the title, so one setting covers Lock the Bar (2 min), (5 min) and so on)

pointsPerLockedMinute.label: Only used when a lock reward's name has no time in it: channel points per locked minute. A name like "Lock the Bar (2 mins)" always locks for exactly that long, whatever it costs

lockMinMinutes.label: Shortest a single lock can be, in minutes

lockMaxMinutes.label: Longest a single lock can be, in minutes

lockMaxTotalMinutes.label: Longest the lock can ever run, in minutes, however many people stack it up

lockBreakSubs.label: Points of subs, cheers and donations piled up against a lock that break it (25 is five tier 1 subs, so a tier 3 counts as four, and 1,250 bits or 12.50 in donations does it too). 0 means a lock cannot be broken

manualLockMinutes.label: Minutes the Lock button below applies

nopeRewardTitle.label: Channel point reward that chips in to save the run (matched on the start of the title, so several rewards at different prices all pay into the same pot alongside subs and bits)

nopeTargetSubs.label: How many points it takes to save the first bar, so 25 means five tier 1 subs' worth of anything at all. It grows with every bar by the same amount the bar does, so saving one always costs about the same share of it

nopeRedeemsToSave.label: This many Save the Run redeems in one window save the run outright, however big the bar has grown, so channel points always count. Each redeem also chips into the save as usual (0 turns the flat cancel off)

moneySavesRun.label: Subs, cheers and donations can help save the run (untick to make Save the Run redeems the only way to save it, counted as a plain number of redeems)

saveRewardCost.label: What the Save the Run reward costs in channel points on Twitch, so that the line under the bar can say how many channel points are left to save the run when subs, cheers and donations are switched off as ways to save it (0 hides the figure)

nopePointsPerSub.label: Channel points that count as one point towards saving the run (so 2000 means a Save the Run redeem at 10000 is worth a tier 1 sub)

subWord.label: Word for one sub (1 sub to go)

toGoText.label: Ending of the line under the bar while it is filling

toBreakText.label: Ending of the line while the bar is locked and subs are breaking the lock

toSaveText.label: Ending of the line while the run can be saved

offNote.label: Line under the bar while it is switched off

endedByText.label: Line under the bar when someone ended the run outright ({who} is their name)

redeemWord.label: Word for one channel point redeem

secondsSuffix.label: Text after the save countdown number

readoutBarText.label: Bar readout while filling ({n} and {total} are filled in)

readoutRedeemsText.label: Bar readout while the run can be saved by redeems

readoutPointsText.label: Bar readout while the run can be saved with points

bankedText.label: Text after a floating amount that is banked during the reset

lockedByText.label: Floating text when someone locks the bar ({who} is their name)

lockedText.label: Floating text when a lock has no name

lockBrokenByText.label: Floating text when someone breaks a lock

lockBrokenText.label: Floating text when a lock is broken with no name

savedByText.label: Floating text when someone saves the run

savedText.label: Floating text when a save has no name

radius.label: Card corner roundness, as a percentage of the box's smaller side

paddingV.label: Space above and below the contents, as a percentage of the box's smaller side

paddingH.label: Space either side of the contents, as a percentage of the box's smaller side

gap.label: Space between the heading, bar and readout, as a percentage of the box's smaller side

tilt.label: Tilt in degrees (negative leans left, 0 is straight)

borderWidth.label: Outline width in pixels (0 for none)

textShadow.label: Soft shadow behind the text, to help it read over bright scenes

showTail.label: Show the little circle tail under the card

trackHeight.label: Bar thickness, as a percentage of the box's smaller side

titleScale.label: Size of the heading compared with the default (1 is the default)

timerScale.label: Size of the countdown compared with the default (1 is the default)

readoutScale.label: Size of the readout compared with the default (1 is the default)

noteScale.label: Size of the line under the bar compared with the default (1 is the default)

noteWeight.label: Boldness of the line under the bar

floatScale.label: Size of the floating text compared with the default (1 is the default)

titleSpacing.label: Space between the heading's letters, in em

noteOpacity.label: Opacity of the line under the bar (0 to 1)

themePreset.label: Style preset (pick Custom to use your own colours below)

colorBg.label: Card colour (used when the preset is Custom)

panelOpacity.label: Card and floating text opacity (used when the preset is Custom; 0 is invisible, 1 is solid)

colorText.label: Text colour (used when the preset is Custom)

colorAccent.label: Accent colour (used when the preset is Custom)

colorFillFrom.label: Bar fill, start (used when the preset is Custom)

colorFillTo.label: Bar fill, end (used when the preset is Custom)

colorAlarm.label: Alarm colour: the card while the run can be saved, and the last stretch (used when the preset is Custom)

colorTitle.label: Heading colour (used when the preset is Custom)

colorTimer.label: Countdown colour (used when the preset is Custom)

colorReadout.label: Readout colour (used when the preset is Custom)

colorNote.label: Line under the bar colour (used when the preset is Custom)

colorBorder.label: Outline colour (used when the preset is Custom)

colorTrack.label: Empty part of the bar colour (used when the preset is Custom)

colorLock.label: Padlock colour (used when the preset is Custom)

colorLockHole.label: Padlock keyhole colour (used when the preset is Custom)

colorFloat.label: Floating text colour (used when the preset is Custom)

colorFloatBg.label: Floating text background colour (used when the preset is Custom)

colorAlert.label: Text while the card is in alarm colour (used when the preset is Custom)

colorAlertFill.label: Bar fill while the card is in alarm colour (used when the preset is Custom)

trackOpacity.label: Empty bar opacity (used when the preset is Custom)

lockedOpacity.label: How faint the fill goes while the bar is locked (0 to 1)

offOpacity.label: How faint the whole card goes while the bar is switched off (0 to 1)

animations.label: Animate (untick to switch every animation off)

fillSeconds.label: Seconds the bar takes to fill

popScale.label: How far the card swells when the bar moves (1 for no swell)

floatSeconds.label: Seconds each floating text stays on screen

dreadSeconds.label: Seconds one breath of the last-stretch glow takes

panicSeconds.label: Seconds one pulse of the save window takes

refuseSeconds.label: Seconds the shake takes when a contribution is turned away

enableSounds.label: Play sounds (the streamer cannot watch the overlay while playing, so this is how they find out)

fullSound.label: When the bar fills and the clock starts

resetSound.label: When the run is gone, whether the clock ran out or somebody ended it outright

addSound.label: Sound when a contribution lands on the bar. Leave empty for none.

lockSound.label: Sound when the bar is locked. Leave empty for none.

breakSound.label: Sound when a lock is broken. Leave empty for none.

manualStep.label: How many points the fill button below adds

btnFillStep.label: Fill the bar a little (five tier 1 subs' worth by default, so testing does not take a hundred clicks)

btnFillBar.label: Fill it all the way and start the clock (this is how you rehearse the panic before going live)

btnNope.label: Save the run by hand, as though someone had noped it

btnOff.label: Switch the bar off (nothing chat spends counts until it is back on)

btnReset.label: Clear everything back to an empty, unlocked bar (the bar keeps the size it has grown to)

btnRestartEscalation.label: Clear everything and go right back to the first bar, at its starting size
